limitations: No measured FP improvement or generalization gain is claimed at deployment.
Training windows use dataset annotations and exclude unknown labels; they are not held-out accuracy.
Resumes and threshold changes start new metric windows with explicit step bounds; unflushed pre-stop windows are not replayed.
The current epoch loss accumulator includes the prior router objective; revision boundaries are recorded.
Candidate utility measures independent views, not guaranteed combined-set improvement.
No A/B/C training, fixed-image prerequisite, teacher weights, new threshold or ASL hyperparameter changes were introduced.
